$comment: Maps T-SQL features to their minimum SQL Server version and compatibility level. Sources: Microsoft Learn docs, community blogs, and official release notes.

SQL Server 2016 SP1.servicePackNote: SP1 added features like CREATE OR ALTER

features.name: DROP IF EXISTS
features.description: DROP <object_type> IF EXISTS syntax for DDL statements (TABLE, VIEW, PROCEDURE, FUNCTION, INDEX, TRIGGER, etc.)

features.name: JSON_VALUE
features.description: Extracts a scalar value from a JSON string

features.name: JSON_QUERY
features.description: Extracts an object or array from a JSON string

features.name: JSON_MODIFY
features.description: Updates the value of a property in a JSON string and returns the updated JSON string

features.name: ISJSON
features.description: Tests whether a string contains valid JSON

features.name: OPENJSON
features.description: Table-valued function that parses JSON text and returns objects and properties as rows and columns

features.name: FOR JSON
features.description: Exports query results as JSON (FOR JSON AUTO, FOR JSON PATH)
features.syntax: SELECT * FROM MyTable FOR JSON PATH

features.name: JSON_OBJECT
features.description: Constructs JSON object text from zero or more expressions

features.name: JSON_ARRAY
features.description: Constructs JSON array text from zero or more expressions

features.name: JSON_OBJECTAGG
features.description: Constructs a JSON object from an aggregation of key-value pairs

features.name: JSON_ARRAYAGG
features.description: Constructs a JSON array from an aggregation of values

features.name: JSON data type
features.description: Native JSON data type (binary storage format)

features.name: STRING_AGG
features.description: Concatenates values of string expressions and places separator values between them

features.name: STRING_SPLIT
features.description: Table-valued function that splits a string into rows of substrings based on a separator

features.name: STRING_ESCAPE
features.description: Escapes special characters in a string and returns the escaped text

features.name: TRANSLATE
features.description: Returns the string with all occurrences of each character in the second argument replaced by the corresponding character in the third argument

features.name: CONCAT_WS
features.description: Concatenates values with a separator (With Separator), skipping NULLs

features.name: TRIM
features.description: Removes the space character or other specified characters from the start and end of a string

features.name: AT TIME ZONE
features.description: Converts a datetime value to a datetimeoffset in the specified time zone (daylight-saving aware)
features.syntax: SELECT GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'Pacific Standard Time'

features.name: CREATE OR ALTER
features.description: Creates or modifies a stored procedure, function, view, or trigger in a single statement
features.syntax: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.MyProc AS ...
features.note: Introduced in SQL Server 2016 SP1, not the initial 2016 RTM release

features.name: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT
features.description: Returns an approximate count of unique non-null values in a group (up to 2% error rate within 97% probability)

features.name: GREATEST
features.description: Returns the greatest value from a list of one or more expressions

features.name: LEAST
features.description: Returns the least value from a list of one or more expressions

features.name: DATE_BUCKET
features.description: Returns the datetime value corresponding to the start of each date bucket from the given origin or default origin

features.name: DATETRUNC
features.description: Truncates a date/time value to a specified datepart

features.name: GENERATE_SERIES
features.description: Generates a series of numbers within a given interval

features.name: WINDOW clause
features.description: Named window definitions in the WINDOW clause, referenced by window functions in SELECT
features.syntax: SELECT SUM(x) OVER w FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY col ORDER BY col2)

features.name: BIT_COUNT
features.description: Returns the number of bits set to 1 in a numeric or binary expression

features.name: GET_BIT
features.description: Returns the bit value at a specified position in an integer expression

features.name: SET_BIT
features.description: Sets the bit at a specified position in an integer expression

features.name: LEFT_SHIFT
features.description: Shifts bits to the left (also available as << operator)

features.name: RIGHT_SHIFT
features.description: Shifts bits to the right (also available as >> operator)

features.name: COMPRESS
features.description: Compresses input data using the GZIP algorithm

features.name: DECOMPRESS
features.description: Decompresses GZIP-compressed data

features.name: SESSION_CONTEXT
features.description: Returns the value of the specified key in the current session context (set via sp_set_session_context)

features.name: CURRENT_TIMEZONE
features.description: Returns the time zone name of the current server

features.name: CURRENT_TIMEZONE_ID
features.description: Returns the IANA time zone ID of the current server

features.name: TRY_CAST
features.description: Attempts a CAST operation and returns NULL if the conversion fails instead of raising an error

features.name: TRY_CONVERT
features.description: Attempts a CONVERT operation and returns NULL if the conversion fails instead of raising an error

features.name: TRY_PARSE
features.description: Attempts a PARSE operation and returns NULL if the parsing fails instead of raising an error

features.name: PARSE
features.description: Parses a string value to a specified data type using .NET culture-aware formatting

features.name: OFFSET / FETCH NEXT
features.description: Paging support in ORDER BY clause: skip rows and fetch a specified number of rows
features.syntax: SELECT * FROM MyTable ORDER BY Id OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

features.name: CREATE SEQUENCE
features.description: Creates a user-defined schema-bound sequence object that generates a sequence of numeric values
features.syntax: CREATE SEQUENCE dbo.MySeq AS INT START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1

features.name: IIF
features.description: Returns one of two values depending on whether the Boolean expression evaluates to true or false

features.name: CHOOSE
features.description: Returns the item at the specified index from a list of values

features.name: FORMAT
features.description: Returns a value formatted with the specified format and optional culture (uses .NET formatting)

features.name: THROW
features.description: Raises an exception and transfers execution to a CATCH block (replacement for RAISERROR in new code)

features.name: ALTER INDEX ... WITH (ONLINE = ON)
features.description: Rebuilds or reorganizes indexes online without blocking concurrent queries (Enterprise Edition only prior to 2016 SP1)
features.syntax: ALTER INDEX IX_Name ON dbo.MyTable REBUILD WITH (ONLINE = ON)
features.note: Available in Enterprise Edition only until SQL Server 2016 SP1 which made some online operations available in Standard Edition

features.name: APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT
features.description: Returns an approximate interpolated value at a given percentile from a set of values (continuous distribution)
features.syntax: SELECT APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY val) FROM MyTable

features.name: APPROX_PERCENTILE_DISC
features.description: Returns an approximate value at a given percentile from a set of values (discrete distribution)
features.syntax: SELECT APPROX_PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY val) FROM MyTable

features.name: IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM
features.description: NULL-safe comparison operator that always returns TRUE or FALSE (never UNKNOWN), treating NULL values as known values for comparison
features.syntax: SELECT * FROM t WHERE col IS DISTINCT FROM @val

features.name: VECTOR data type
features.description: Native vector data type for storing high-dimensional embeddings
features.syntax: CREATE TABLE embeddings (id INT, embedding VECTOR(1536))

features.name: VECTOR_DISTANCE
features.description: Calculates the distance between two vectors using cosine, Euclidean, or dot-product metrics

features.name: VECTOR_SEARCH
features.description: Approximate nearest neighbor search using DiskANN-based vector indexes

features.name: AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS
features.description: Generates vector embeddings from within the database using configured AI model endpoints

features.name: CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL
features.description: Defines and invokes external AI model endpoints (Azure AI, OpenAI, Ollama, etc.)

features.name: COPY INTO
features.description: High-throughput data ingestion from external storage (Azure Blob / ADLS Gen2)
features.note: Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric only. Not available in SQL Server on-premises.

features.name: Temporal Tables (FOR SYSTEM_TIME)
features.description: System-versioned temporal tables that automatically track the full history of data changes
features.syntax: SELECT * FROM MyTable FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF '2025-01-01'

features.name: Graph Tables (AS NODE)
features.description: Create graph node tables for graph database scenarios
features.syntax: CREATE TABLE Person (Name VARCHAR(100)) AS NODE

features.name: Graph Tables (AS EDGE)
features.description: Create graph edge tables representing relationships between nodes
features.syntax: CREATE TABLE Follows (StartDate DATE) AS EDGE

features.name: MATCH (Graph)
features.description: Pattern matching for graph queries using ASCII-art style syntax
features.syntax: SELECT * FROM Person p1, Follows f, Person p2 WHERE MATCH(p1-(f)->p2)

features.name: REGEXP_LIKE
features.description: Returns TRUE if a string matches a regular expression pattern
features.note: Requires compatibility level 170 for REGEXP_LIKE specifically

features.name: REGEXP_REPLACE
features.description: Replaces occurrences of a regular expression pattern in a string

features.name: REGEXP_SUBSTR
features.description: Returns a substring that matches a regular expression pattern

features.name: REGEXP_INSTR
features.description: Returns the starting or ending position of a regex pattern match in a string

features.name: REGEXP_COUNT
features.description: Returns the number of times a regex pattern matches in a string

features.name: EDIT_DISTANCE / EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY
features.description: Calculates the Damerau-Levenshtein edit distance between two strings

features.name: JARO_WINKLER_DISTANCE / JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY
features.description: Calculates similarity between two strings using the Jaro-Winkler algorithm

features.name: BASE64_ENCODE / BASE64_DECODE
features.description: Base-64 encoding and decoding functions

features.name: PRODUCT
features.description: Aggregate function that returns the product of all values in an expression

features.name: || (String concatenation operator)
features.description: ANSI SQL standard string concatenation operator as alternative to +

features.name: UNISTR
features.description: Unicode string encoding function

features.name: DATEDIFF_BIG
features.description: Returns the count of datepart boundaries crossed between two dates as a BIGINT

features.name: CONCAT
features.description: Concatenates two or more strings, treating NULL as empty string

features.name: EOMONTH
features.description: Returns the last day of the month for the specified date

features.name: DATEFROMPARTS / TIMEFROMPARTS / DATETIMEFROMPARTS / etc.
features.description: Constructs date/time values from individual parts (year, month, day, etc.)

features.name: EXECUTE ... WITH RESULT SETS
features.description: Redefine the result set metadata of a stored procedure execution
features.syntax: EXEC dbo.MyProc WITH RESULT SETS ((col1 INT, col2 VARCHAR(50)))

SQL Server 2017 (compat 140): Graph tables (AS NODE / AS EDGE / MATCH)
